entries.description: Alɣu agraɣlan n yizerfan n umdan
entries.subject: Alɣu agraɣlan

spans.text: Alɣu agraɣlan n yizerfan n umdan

Iberreḥ-d belli alɣu-agi agraɣlan n yizerfan n umdan d uktu yezdin iɣer ssaramen yimdanen d yiɣlanen akken ma llan iwakken akk imdanen d yiɛeggalen n tmetti i yettarran dima alɣu-agi di lbal-nsen, ad sxedmen akk lmeǧhud-nsen, s uselmed akked usegmi iwakken ad senernin aqader n tlelliyin d yizerfan-agi, yerna ad ḍemnen s ttawilat yettnernayen deg uswir aɣelnaw d uswir agraɣlan, asteɛṛef d usnas ameɣrudan n tidet n tlelliyin d yizerfan-agi, ama gar yimezdaɣ n tmura tiɛeggalin, neɣ gar yimezdaɣ n tmizar yellan ddaw n leḥkem-nsent.

entries.task_id: akk yiɛeggalen|n|twacult talsawt d yizerfan-nsen yegdan
entries.description: akk yiɛeggalen n twacult talsawt d yizerfan-nsen yegdan
entries.subject: akk yiɛeggalen

spans.text: Imi asteɛṛef s lḥerma i ttalasen akk yiɛeggalen n twacult talsawt d yizerfan-nsen yegdan, d nutni i d llsas n tlelli, taɣdemt akked tifrat deg umaḍal,

spans.text: Imi kra n wid ur nessemras ara izerfan n umdan d wid i ten-iḥeqren llan-d d sseba n thamaǧit i yesserfayen tamsakit n talsa akked tlelliyin deg umaḍal anda imdanen ad meslayen, ad amnen s tlelli ideg ur yelli la aserḥeb la lmizirya, d tilelli i d assirem ɛlayan n umdan,

Ula d yiwen ur yettwaḥkam ara fell-as ma yexdem kra n utɛeddi neɣ yezgel ur yexdim ara kra n tigawt ilezmen fell-as, ma yella di tallit-nni ayen yexdem ur ixulef ara asaḍuf aɣelnaw neɣ agraɣlan, yerna ma yewwi-d ad yettwaɛaqeb, ur ilaq lɛuquba-s ad tagar tin i yeḥkem fell-as usaḍuf di tallit ideg yeḍra utɛeddi.

entries.description: d nnig n kra yellan
entries.subject: d nnig

spans.text: Imi tewwi-d nnig n kra yellan, ad ttwaḥudden yizerfan n umdan s udabu azerfan iwakken ur yettwaḥras ara umdan di taggara alamma yuɣal d aɣewwaɣ mgal tamḥeqranit akked unaɣur,

entries.task_id: yaf ilmend|n|ccetla d yini d tuzzuft d tutlayt d tesreḍt akked rṛạy as ertan neɣ ṛṛay-nniḍen
entries.description: yaf ilmend n ccetla d yini d tuzzuft d tutlayt d tesreḍt akked rṛạy as ertan neɣ ṛṛay-nniḍen
entries.subject: yaf ilmend
entries.object: ccetla d yini d tuzzuft d tutlayt d tesreḍt akked rṛạy as ertan neɣ ṛṛay-nniḍen

spans.text: Yal yiwen ɣur-s azref ad iɣellet tilelliyin d yizerfan i d-yeddan deg walɣu-agi war ma yella-d meḥyaf ilmend n ccetla d yini d tuzzuft d tutlayt d tesreḍt akked rṛạy as ertan neɣ ṛṛay-nniḍen, neɣ ilmend n laṣel aɣelnaw neɣ imetti, neɣ ilmend n ssɛaya d tlalit, neɣ kra n waddad-nniḍen.

Rnu ɣer-s, ur ilaq ara ad yemmag lxilaf gar yimdanen ilmend n uẓayer asertan neɣ azerfan neɣ ilmend n uẓayer agraɣlan n tmurt neɣ n temnaḍt ideg yezdeɣ umdan, i tebɣu tili tmurt-agi neɣ temnaḍt-agi d tamunant, neɣ tella ddaw n leɛnaya n tmurt-nniḍen, neɣ ur teḥkim ara deg yiman-is, neɣ ur tekmil ara tlelli-s.

entries.description: neɣ ilmend n ssɛaya d tlalit
entries.subject: neɣ ilmend

spans.text: Yal yiwen ɣur-s azref ad iɣellet tilelliyin d yizerfan i d-yeddan deg walɣu-agi war ma yella-d meḥyaf ilmend n ccetla d yini d tuzzuft d tutlayt d tesreḍt akked rṛạy as ertan neɣ ṛṛay-nniḍen, neɣ ilmend n laṣel aɣelnaw neɣ imetti, neɣ ilmend n ssɛaya d tlalit, neɣ kra n waddad-nniḍen.

entries.description: neɣ kra n waddad-nniḍen
entries.subject: neɣ kra

spans.text: Yal yiwen ɣur-s azref ad iɣellet tilelliyin d yizerfan i d-yeddan deg walɣu-agi war ma yella-d meḥyaf ilmend n ccetla d yini d tuzzuft d tutlayt d tesreḍt akked rṛạy as ertan neɣ ṛṛay-nniḍen, neɣ ilmend n laṣel aɣelnaw neɣ imetti, neɣ ilmend n ssɛaya d tlalit, neɣ kra n waddad-nniḍen.

Amru n ugdud, d netta i d llsas n udabu azayez, amru-ya yessefk ad d-iban s tefranin zeddigen ara d-yettezzin yal tikkelt, ideg ara ttekkin meṛṛa madden s tigda d tuffra deg ufan, neɣ s kra n ttawi- nniḍen i icuban aya, ara iḍemnen tilelli n tefrant.

entries.description: tella ddaw n leɛnaya n tmurt-nniḍen
entries.subject: tella ddaw

spans.text: Rnu ɣer-s, ur ilaq ara ad yemmag lxilaf gar yimdanen ilmend n uẓayer asertan neɣ azerfan neɣ ilmend n uẓayer agraɣlan n tmurt neɣ n temnaḍt ideg yezdeɣ umdan, i tebɣu tili tmurt-agi neɣ temnaḍt-agi d tamunant, neɣ tella ddaw n leɛnaya n tmurt-nniḍen, neɣ ur teḥkim ara deg yiman-is, neɣ ur tekmil ara tlelli-s.

entries.description: s azref n tudert
entries.subject: s azref

spans.text: Yal amdan ɣur-s azref n tudert, tilelli d teɣlist ɣef yiman-is.

entries.description: d aqeddac n umdan-nniḍen
entries.subject: d aqeddac

spans.text: Ur ilaq ara ad yuɣal umdan d akli neɣ d aqeddac n umdan-nniḍen.

entries.task_id: azenzi|n|waklan yettwagdel i tebɣu tili talɣa-s
entries.description: Azenzi n waklan yettwagdel i tebɣu tili talɣa-s
entries.subject: Azenzi
entries.object: waklan yettwagdel i tebɣu tili talɣa-s

spans.text: Azenzi n waklan yettwagdel i tebɣu tili talɣa-s.

entries.description: gdan zdat n usaḍuf
entries.subject: gdan zdat

spans.text: Akk imdanen gdan zdat n usaḍuf, ɣur-sen azref war meḥyaf iwakken ad ten-iḥud usaḍuf, ɣur-sen meṛṛa azref i uḥuddu yegdan mgal meḥyaf ideg ur yettwaquder ara walɣu-agi.

entries.description: Kra n win yettutehmen s utɛeddi
entries.subject: Kra

spans.text: Kra n win yettutehmen s utɛeddi, ad yettwaḥsab d amelsan alamma yettwaseɣti s tigda ddenb i d-gren fell-as, taluft-is yewwi-d ad tɛeddi ɛinani deg teɣdemt, anda ara yettwaḍmen akk wayen i ilaqen i uḥuddu-ines.

entries.description: di tudert n umdan
entries.subject: di tudert

spans.text: Ur yezmir ḥedd ad yessekcem iman-is s lǧur di tudert n umdan, di twacult-is, deg uxxam-is d tmuzniwin-is, naɣ ad yessimes lḥerma-s d nnif-is ; yal amdan ɣur-s azref ad t-iḥudd usaḍuf seg tyitwin yecban tigi.

entries.description: deg ugens n uwanek
entries.subject: deg ugens

spans.text: Yal amdan ɣur-s azref ad yelḥu s tlelli, ɣur-s azref ad yextir tamezduɣt deg ugens n uwanek.

entries.description: deg leɛnaya n tmura nniḍen
entries.subject: deg leɛnaya

spans.text: Ma yella yettwaḥṛes umdan s lǧur, ɣur-s azref ad yesdari iman-is, ad yidir deg leɛnaya n tmura nniḍen.

entries.description: d yimenẓayen n Yiɣlanen Yedduklen
entries.subject: d yimenẓayen

spans.text: Ur yettunefk ara uzref-a i win yettutehmen s tidet s twuɣa akked utɛeddi ɣef yimdanen, neɣ yexdem ayen ixulfen iswiyen d yimenẓayen n Yiɣlanen Yedduklen.

entries.description: la azref n ubeddel n teɣlent
entries.subject: la azref

spans.text: Ur d-as-yettwakkas i yiwen s lǧur la taɣlent-ines la azref n ubeddel n teɣlent.

entries.description: lebɣi ukmil n urgaz d tmeṭṭut
entries.subject: lebɣi ukmil

spans.text: Ur yettili zzwaǧ alamma s lebɣi ukmil n urgaz d tmeṭṭut.

entries.description: agaman agejdan n tmetti
entries.subject: agaman agejdan

spans.text: Tawacult d aferdis agaman agejdan n tmetti, ɣur-s azref ad tḥudd fell-as tmetti akked uwanek.

entries.task_id: i tlelli|n|tedmi d tefrit akked tedreḍt
entries.description: i tlelli n tedmi d tefrit akked tedreḍt
entries.subject: i tlelli

spans.text: Yal amdan ɣur-s azref i tlelli n tedmi d tefrit akked tedreḍt, azref-a tettekki deg-s tlelli n ubeddel n tesreḍt neɣ taflest, yerna ɣur-s tilelli ad d-yesban tasreḍt-is neɣ taflest-is ama weḥdes neɣ d tarbaɛt, ɛinani neɣ di sser, s uselmed d yisekkiren d uɛbad.

entries.description: s azref n tlelli n ṛṛay d umeslay ideg izeddi uzref n usbeggen n ṛṛay war ma yettucewwel bab-is
entries.subject: s azref
entries.object: tlelli n ṛṛay d umeslay ideg izeddi uzref n usbeggen n ṛṛay war ma yettucewwel bab-is

spans.text: Yal amdan ɣur-s azref n tlelli n ṛṛay d umeslay ideg izeddi uzref n usbeggen n ṛṛay war ma yettucewwel bab-is, daɣen ɣur-s azref ad inadi, ad yeṭṭef, ad yezzuzer isallen d tektiwin, war ma yettwaqeyyed s tlisa n trakalt, akken bɣun ilin wallalen n taywalt i yessemres.

Alɣu agraɣlan n yizerfan n umdan

Iberreḥ-d belli alɣu-agi agraɣlan n yizerfan n umdan d uktu yezdin iɣer ssaramen yimdanen d yiɣlanen akken ma llan iwakken akk imdanen d yiɛeggalen n tmetti i yettarran dima alɣu-agi di lbal-nsen, ad sxedmen akk lmeǧhud-nsen, s uselmed akked usegmi iwakken ad senernin aqader n tlelliyin d yizerfan-agi, yerna ad ḍemnen s ttawilat yettnernayen deg uswir aɣelnaw d uswir agraɣlan, asteɛṛef d usnas ameɣrudan n tidet n tlelliyin d yizerfan-agi, ama gar yimezdaɣ n tmura tiɛeggalin, neɣ gar yimezdaɣ n tmizar yellan ddaw n leḥkem-nsent.

folded.object: win i yextar s tlelli akken ad t-imetel

spans.text: Yal amdan ɣur-s azref ad yettekki deg useddu n temsal tizuyaz n tmurt-is, ama d netta s timmad-is, neɣ s ubrid n win i yextar s tlelli akken ad t-imetel.

folded.id: sab|n|tuddsa d yiɣbula n yal tamurt
folded.subject: sab
folded.object: tuddsa d yiɣbula n yal tamurt

spans.text: Yal amdan s ṣṣifa-ines d aɛeggal deg tmetti, ɣur-s azref deg teɣlist timettit i d-yellan ilmend n usnerni n yizerfan idamsanen, d yizerfan imettiyen d yidelsanen i yesɛan tixuṭṭert deg uḥraz n lḥeṛma-s d unegmu ilelli n tugna-s, aya yettili-d ilmend n lǧehd aɣelnaw d umyawas agraɣlan, ɛlaḥsab n tuddsa d yiɣbula n yal tamurt.

Iberreḥ-d belli alɣu-agi agraɣlan n yizerfan n umdan d uktu yezdin iɣer ssaramen yimdanen d yiɣlanen akken ma llan iwakken akk imdanen d yiɛeggalen n tmetti i yettarran dima alɣu-agi di lbal-nsen, ad sxedmen akk lmeǧhud-nsen, s uselmed akked usegmi iwakken ad senernin aqader n tlelliyin d yizerfan-agi, yerna ad ḍemnen s ttawilat yettnernayen deg uswir aɣelnaw d uswir agraɣlan, asteɛṛef d usnas ameɣrudan n tidet n tlelliyin d yizerfan-agi, ama gar yimezdaɣ n tmura tiɛeggalin, neɣ gar yimezdaɣ n tmizar yellan ddaw n leḥkem-nsent.

Rnu ɣer-s, ur ilaq ara ad yemmag lxilaf gar yimdanen ilmend n uẓayer asertan neɣ azerfan neɣ ilmend n uẓayer agraɣlan n tmurt neɣ n temnaḍt ideg yezdeɣ umdan, i tebɣu tili tmurt-agi neɣ temnaḍt-agi d tamunant, neɣ tella ddaw n leɛnaya n tmurt-nniḍen, neɣ ur teḥkim ara deg yiman-is, neɣ ur tekmil ara tlelli-s.

Imi deg umtawa n yigduden n Ugraw n Yiɣlanen Yedduklen, berrḥen i tikkelt-nniḍen s laman i sɛan deg yizerfan addayen n umdan, deg lḥerma akked wazal n bnadem, deg tigda n yizerfan n tlawin d yirgazen, berrḥen belli qes den ad snernin afara imetti, yerna ad sbedden tignatin yelhan n tudert di tlelli yettimɣuren,
Yal amdan ɣur-s azref am netta am wiyaḍ ad yeṭṭef amkan deg twuri tazayezt n tmurt-is.

spans.text: Yal yiwen ɣur-s azref ad iɣellet tilelliyin d yizerfan i d-yeddan deg walɣu-agi war ma yella-d meḥyaf ilmend n ccetla d yini d tuzzuft d tutlayt d tesreḍt akked rṛạy as ertan neɣ ṛṛay-nniḍen, neɣ ilmend n laṣel aɣelnaw neɣ imetti, neɣ ilmend n ssɛaya d tlalit, neɣ kra n waddad-nniḍen.
